signal: Eventus won Market Surveillance Solution of the Year at FOW 2026, swept the Regulation Asia Awards, and launched its Frank natural-language AI tool for Validus

email.body1:
Scott, saw Eventus sweep the FOW and Regulation Asia awards and ship the Frank AI tool for Validus.

Global recognition like that usually pulls in more in-market firms than even a strong sales org can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Eventus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Scott, quick follow-up for Eventus.

When awards drive global demand, expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount can across regions. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Eventus needs across global surveillance accounts this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Scott, last bit of proof for Eventus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Eventus' reply rate likely compares to other enterprise regtech companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Scott, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling global pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running sales worldwide is busy enough.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global regtech motion? I'll tailor it to Eventus either way.
